tooltip.quantumitems.strand_wand.use: Click two blocks to stretch a strand. Sneak-click the air for the next colour, a block to clear.
tooltip.quantumitems.strand_wand.creativ: A creative toy. Only you can see what you paint.
tooltip.quantumitems.window.shared: All copies share one supply of items. Take from any copy and every copy loses them.
tooltip.quantumitems.window.ground: Drop it on the ground and it turns back into ordinary items.
tooltip.quantumitems.window.automation: Hoppers and pipes pull ordinary items out. Taking the last one ends the link.
tooltip.quantumitems.window.shulker: Safe to keep in a shulker box.
quantumitems.ponder.tag.quantum_entangle: Link stacks together so that taking items from one takes them from all.
quantumitems.ponder.circle.text_1: The ritual circle is built on a 5×5 floor of Amethyst Blocks
quantumitems.ponder.circle.text_2: Place a Resonator on each of the four corners
quantumitems.ponder.circle.text_3: Each Resonator holds a single stack of items
quantumitems.ponder.circle.text_4: The Quantum Core stands at the center of the circle
quantumitems.ponder.circle.text_5: The space above the floor must stay clear of other blocks
quantumitems.ponder.circle.text_6: Once the circle is complete, it is ready to entangle items
quantumitems.ponder.create.text_1: Lay a single stack on just one Resonator
quantumitems.ponder.create.text_2: Then place a Quantum Knot on the Core to start the ritual
quantumitems.ponder.create.text_3: One Knot turns that stack into two entangled windows
quantumitems.ponder.create.text_4: The Knot is spent either way, success or failure
quantumitems.ponder.expand.text_1: To grow a network, first lay out every window it already has
quantumitems.ponder.expand.text_2: Then run the ritual again with another Knot
quantumitems.ponder.expand.text_3: Each ritual entangles one more window into the network
quantumitems.ponder.expand.text_4: The network caps at four windows — one for each Resonator
quantumitems.ponder.failure.text_1: A new network takes exactly ONE stack, and it must be stackable with no durability
quantumitems.ponder.failure.text_2: One Resonator must stay empty — that is where the new window appears
quantumitems.ponder.failure.text_3: If a rule is broken the ritual stops. The Knot is used up; your items stay where they are
quantumitems.ponder.failure.text_4: To grow a network, lay out every window it has — and nothing else
